incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A multi-storey building is partially collapsed, with rubble scattered on the ground. Dust is visible in the air, and surrounding structures are intact but show signs of damage.

observations.description: A multi-storey building is severely damaged, with part of it collapsed and debris covering the ground.
No visible water; debris is dry and scattered on the ground.
No visible people in the image.
Trees and some greenery are visible nearby the collapsed building.
A street pole is partially visible. Adjacent buildings are intact but show minor damage.
No vehicles visible in the image.

inconsistencies: Report mentions dust covering the street — visible in the image, but not as a prominent feature.
Report mentions residents may still be inside — no visible people in the image, so not confirmed.
not_determinable: Number of floors in the collapsed building
Scale of damage to other structures
Distance from the collapse site to other buildings
